name: Risk Assessment 4
definition: Indicates to the card issuer the level of risk associated with the transaction.

EntityType.name: Entity Type
EntityType.definition: Type of entity who assess the risk for the transaction. P000-P999 reserved for private use, N000-N999 reserved for national use.

HighRiskTransaction.name: High Risk Transaction
HighRiskTransaction.definition: Transaction is identified as high risk.

Reason.name: Reason
Reason.definition: Reason for indicating a certain level of risk for the transaction.

Condition.name: Condition
Condition.definition: Conditions noted for the risk assessment.

Recommendation.name: Recommendation
Recommendation.definition: Additional details of recommended action or other recommended action.

PrivateData.name: Private Data
PrivateData.definition: Reserved for private data. The use of this data element is determined by bilateral agreement.

NationalData.name: National Data
NationalData.definition: Reserved to define data unique to the country applications.
